edgeCases: Search empty string: must return all products — no filtering applied
Search case-insensitive: 'MOUSE' must match 'Wireless Mouse' — both sides lowercased before comparison
Search substring: 'mouse' matches within longer product name — not prefix-only
Search whitespace: trim applied before match — '  lamp  ' matches 'Desk Lamp'
Category 'All': bypass category filter entirely — all products pass
Category exact match: 'Fitness' returns exactly 5 products; wrong category returns 0 (triggers empty state)
inStockOnly false: no filter applied; true: exclude 4 out-of-stock products (ids 2,5,9,12), leaving 11
Sort default: preserve original API response order — do NOT sort
Sort price-asc: strict full 15-item order by price ascending (Jump Rope $15 first, Headphones $149 last)
Sort price-desc: reverse of price-asc (Headphones first, Jump Rope last)
Sort rating-desc: highest rating first (Yoga Mat 4.8, Mechanical Keyboard 4.7)
No source array mutation: use [...products] or .filter() before .sort()
Filter composition: search AND category AND inStockOnly all apply simultaneously; sort applied after all filters
Clear filters exact reset: search='', category='All', inStockOnly=false, sortBy='default' — results-count must show 'Showing 15 products'
Results-count string: 'Showing 1 products' — tests expect no singular/plural special-casing
Empty state already rendered by ProductList when products.length === 0 — no additional implementation needed
